g.text: 5 V is for downstream supplies. Do not tie the FPGA 1 V core to ESP32-P4 HP power.

g.desc: 5 V is for downstream supplies. Do not tie the FPGA 1 V core to ESP32-P4 HP power.

g.text: 3 A is the IC rating, not a verified board capacity. Inductor current, fault behavior, thermal and load budgets pending.

g.desc: 3 A is the IC rating, not a verified board capacity. Inductor current, fault behavior, thermal and load budgets pending.

g.text: Sunlord inductors selected; load/fault/thermal, effective capacitance and Sydney total cost remain to verify.

g.text: PCB: minimize VIN-CIN-GND and SW/BOOT loops; sense output after L101; quiet FB return.
